# nuewire/cache

> 标签: artisan, cache, laravel, livewire, nuewire

## 简介

A safe Laravel cache management page and command for the Nuewire platform.

按 require.php 推断最低支持 PHP 8；已收录于 php-v8。

- 官网：https://packagist.org/packages/nuewire%2Fcache
